cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(purrvect VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(THORVG REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET thorvg-1>=1.0.7)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_library(purrvect src/purrvect.cpp)
set_target_properties(purrvect PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(purrvect PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
target_link_libraries(purrvect PRIVATE PkgConfig::THORVG Threads::Threads)
add_executable(purrvect_cli src/main.cpp)
set_target_properties(purrvect_cli PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME purrvect)
target_link_libraries(purrvect_cli PRIVATE purrvect)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS purrvect purrvect_cli ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(FILES include/purrvect.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
